entries.action: Honor Retry-After when provided; otherwise bounded exponential backoff with jitter. Check quota telemetry. Do not loop without a cooldown.
entries.verification: A later successful authorized API request; a 429 alone does not prove which quota was exhausted.

entries.action: Retry with bounded exponential backoff and jitter; fall back only to an available authorized provider; preserve checkpoint.
entries.verification: Successful later request and completed checkpoint.

entries.action: Open a payment circuit breaker; do not retry until credit status changes or cooldown expires. Continue Gemini and deterministic work.
entries.verification: Authorized request succeeds after balance restoration.

entries.action: Stop snapshot writes, preserve readable snapshots, inspect disk and WAL/TOAST, provision capacity or restore from verified backup. Never delete original state before verified restore.
entries.verification: Read, checksum, and successful write of new revision.

entries.action: Report infrastructure failure, not failed assertions. Verify runtime/image availability before retry.
entries.verification: Test runner actually executes test cases and returns results.
